about: The mutant ledger of internal/sketch/lawfix, the law pass of ergo fix (types.md, Laws 15): edits that TestPlanPlacesEveryLaw, a seeded property against a reference placement, must kill. Run it with go run ./scripts/mutants lawfix.

mutants.name: lawloc-fix-drops-helper
mutants.rule: ergo fix moves each helper that only laws use beside the first law that uses it.

mutants.name: lawloc-fix-first-subject
mutants.rule: A law or test named for one of its subjects (SortPermutes for Sort) goes beside that subject, not beside the first one it names.

mutants.name: lawloc-fix-no-import
mutants.from: missing = append(missing, missingImport{isGo: isGo, path: impPath, line: formatImportLine(isGo, "", s)})
mutants.rule: A moved law, test or helper takes the imports it names to its new file.

mutants.name: lawloc-fix-keeps-dead-import
mutants.rule: An import that only moved declarations named leaves the file with them (else S110).

mutants.name: lawloc-fix-keeps-laws-file
mutants.rule: A file of laws left holding other declarations is named by its concept, so no file of laws is left.

mutants.name: lawloc-fix-helper-churns
mutants.to: stays = stays || ends(u) == fileOf[h.Decl] && u == h.User
mutants.rule: A helper stays where one of its users stays or arrives, so a second ergo fix moves nothing (the integrator reruns it on a merged head).

mutants.name: lawloc-fix-drops-provider
mutants.rule: A provider the member laws run against, written in a file of laws for them, goes beside their operation type (examples/shards refusing).

mutants.name: fix-leftover-test-unnamed
mutants.rule: A file of laws left holding only tests is a test file: ergo fix renames it tests.ergo, never after a Go type string.

mutants.name: fix-leftover-rename-reported-deleted
mutants.rule: ergo fix reports a renamed file as renamed, not as deleted with no declaration left.

mutants.name: fix-leftover-tests-file-ignored
mutants.origin: wf10 FIX-LEFTOVER r2 (dray: tests.ergo already there)
mutants.rule: A file of laws left holding only tests joins its tests to the package's tests.ergo when there is one, rather than keeping its laws name.

mutants.name: colocate-fix-skips-tests
mutants.rule: ergo fix relocates misplaced top-level test declarations beside their main subject.

mutants.name: colocate-fix-unsorted-imports
mutants.rule: Transferred imports are inserted in sorted order.

mutants.name: colocate-fix-clash-ignores-local
mutants.rule: Clash-avoiding import aliases skip local names bound inside arriving declarations.

mutants.name: colocate-fix-unalias-skipped
mutants.rule: An import alias from a clashing source file is unaliased when its default name does not clash in the destination.

mutants.name: colocate-fix-keeps-empty-file
mutants.rule: A source file left with no declarations after relocating tests and laws is deleted.

mutants.name: colocate-fix-test-exported-helper-ignored
mutants.rule: Exported helpers in tests.ergo or *_test.ergo used only by laws and tests are unexported and relocated just like those in laws files.

mutants.name: colocate-fix-multi-subject-churns
mutants.rule: A law or test already in a file declaring one of its subjects stays put.

mutants.name: colocate-fix-renames-suffixed-test-file
mutants.rule: An existing test file left holding only unplaced tests keeps its name (preserving platform suffixes such as *_linux_test.ergo).
